description: Access skill for Baidu Baike (百度百科) - China's largest encyclopedia.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - search   Search for encyclopedia entries in Baidu Baike by keyword.
  - get_lemma   Retrieve detailed information about an encyclopedia entry.
  - get_movie_info   Get movie-specific information from an encyclopedia entry.

url.description: Full URL to the lemma page (e.g., https://baike.baidu.com/item/八佰)

lemma_id.description: Lemma ID (limited support - use keyword or url instead)
